puzzle.hint: A beloved verse reminding believers that Allah has made the Quran easy to learn, reflect upon, and remember — a source of encouragement for anyone engaging with the Book of Allah.
puzzle.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
